event_vocabulary: frozen Stage 4 visual event IDs; bilingual explanation pairs

contract.en: Buffer complete records before commit, close on every contract exit and preserve output grammar.
contract.vi: Giữ đủ record trước commit, đóng file trên mọi exit và bảo toàn grammar output.

errors.en: Each error detection and repair phase points to executable assertions.
errors.vi: Error detection và repair đều trỏ assertion chạy được.

marking.en: Keep marking-atom joins to their source part and pattern owner.
marking.vi: Giữ join marking atom với source part và pattern owner.

method.en: Open → buffer/convert → route or select → commit/write → close.
method.vi: Open → buffer/convert → route or select → commit/write → close.

recognition.en: Identify the file, fixed record, append/overwrite mode and physical/logical order.
recognition.vi: Nhận diện file, record cố định, mode append/overwrite và thứ tự vật lý/logical.

visual.en: Use the 23 visual event IDs frozen in the inventory.
visual.vi: Dùng đúng 23 visual event IDs frozen trong inventory.

source_boundary: Official QP/MS locators remain authoritative; AlgoCore adaptation is labelled separately.
